game: DAL@DEN Week 8 2025, kickoff 2025-10-26 16:25 ET, Empower Field outdoors, DEN -3.5, total 51.5

script.base: Denver is a 3.5-point home favorite in a 51.5 game, implied DEN 27.5 / DAL 24.0, so the book expects a competitive high-scoring afternoon rather than a blowout or a slog. Denver leans on J.K. Dobbins (48 carries, 200 yards in weeks 5-7) to manage a lead, while Dallas as the dog throws: George Pickens has been the downfield engine (21 targets, 307 yards, 304 air yards) with CeeDee Lamb quiet in that same window (8 targets, 110 yards).
script.flip1: Denver gets up by two scores early, Dobbins runs the clock, and Dallas's deep shots stall — Pickens' 14.5 aDOT profile dies and Evan Engram's targets dry up late the way a clock-kill stalls pass-game overs.
script.flip2: Dallas hangs around or leads, so Javonte Williams (48 carries, 280 yards in weeks 5-7) stays on the field and it becomes a shootout; or unsaved outdoor weather turns the 51.5 into a defensive slog and both receiving overs fail together.

injury_fallout: No DAL or DEN skill-position player is Out on the pre-game nflverse report, so there is no offensive next-man-up. DAL OL is the offensive risk: T Tyler Guyton Questionable (glute), C Cooper Beebe Questionable (ankle), T Ajani Cornelius Questionable (knee). If they sit, pressure rises, rush efficiency falls, and quick throws (Jake Ferguson 19 targets / 111 yards, Williams 14 targets at -5 air) gain while Pickens' deep yards lose. The coverage fallout is all on Dallas's defense: CB Trevon Diggs Out (concussion), CB Shavon Revel Jr. Out (knee), S Donovan Wilson Out (elbow), S Juanyeh Thomas Questionable (illness), LB DeMarvion Overshown Out (knee), DE Marshawn Kneeland Questionable (ankle). Missing CBs and a safety help Courtland Sutton / Troy Franklin / Marvin Mims deep; missing Overshown helps Engram and checkdowns. No DEN defender is listed out. Inactives ~90 minutes before kick are not in the pack. Sources: pack injury report and weeks 5-7 target/carry splits.

matchup.shell: Not charted. Pack has no MOFO/MOFC or man/zone rates, so the shell is unknown and cannot be used as an edge.
matchup.pressure: DEN blitzes 34%. Dak Prescott EPA/dropback is +0.23 vs blitz and +0.26 vs no blitz, so the offense still functions when blitzed, but a 34% blitz plus questionable tackles is a threat to deep yards specifically (Williams' 14 checkdown targets at -5 air show where blitz EPA can hide). DAL blitzes 27%. Bo Nix is better when blitzed (+0.17 EPA/db vs +0.04 not blitzed), which fits quick throws to Engram rather than Franklin's unconverted deep shots (19 targets, 73 yards, 258 air).
matchup.bleeds: DEN run defense is stingy: 3.90 YPC and only 8 runs of 10+ in 7 games. DEN pass locations: left 4.64 YPA (83 att), middle 7.14 (49), right 8.07 (90); 17 passes of 20+ for 256 yards. DAL run defense bleeds: 4.98 YPC and 30 runs of 10+ in 7 games. DAL pass locations: left 9.10 YPA (97), middle 9.75 (36), right 6.77 (104); 24 passes of 20+ for 252 yards.
matchup.overlap: Pickens' 304 air yards are the overlap with Denver's soft right side (8.07 YPA) and middle (7.14), not with their run front. Engram's 20 targets / 60 air yards overlap Dallas's middle (9.75 YPA) and the vacant Overshown LB spot. Sutton (23 targets, 244 air, only 203 yards) overlaps the wiped DAL secondary but sits under an 81.5 line on recent production, so he is not a leg.

form: Avoiding season averages. Pickens last4 receiving yards 134, 57, 168, 82 and weeks 5-7 total 307 on 21 targets — three clears of 68.5, one miss, role is WR1 while Lamb has only 8 targets in that window (season log of 3 games: 110, 112, 110, line 110.5 is a push not an edge). Engram last4 29, 33, 42, 42 on a 6-game median; weeks 5-7 20 targets / 117 yards (39/game) vs a 31.5 line. Ferguson last4 40, 49, 33, 29 vs 40.5 is a coin flip. Williams rush last4 85, 135, 29, 116 (280 yards on 48 carries, 5.83 YPC) is hot but against a 3.90 YPC Denver front — considered, not selected. Dobbins last4 101, 79, 40, 81 and only 66.7 yards/game in weeks 5-7 vs 79.5 — matchup lean dropped because recent form disagrees. Franklin 73 yards on 258 air is not converting. Mims last4 69, 10, 30, 85 is too volatile. Miles Sanders is on the board (rush 28.5; last4 53, 15, 41, 8) but absent from the weeks 5-7 rusher list. Sources: pack L3 splits and stand-in last4 logs.

Blowout snap risk is limited at -3.5. Board allows only rushyds, recyds, rushrecyds — no receptions, no passing yards, no TDs.

data_check.notes: No sims and no Pinnacle (or Circa/BetOnline) two-sided prices in the pack; every main line is 'no price' and no-vig is N/A, so the +3 pt gate and any stake cannot be run. Stand-in lines are season medians, not a sharp anchor. Directional data agrees with both selected legs: Pickens weeks 5-7 ~102 rec yds/game and last4 134/57/168/82 vs 68.5; Engram ~39/game and last4 29/33/42/42 vs 31.5. model_p values are manual discounts of those hit rates, not sim outputs, and are held under 0.70 because the skill's own calibration note says 70-80% ratings have hit near 50%. Dobbins rush over 79.5 was a lean matchup read (DAL allows 4.98 YPC and 30 runs of 10+) but weeks 5-7 are only 66.7 yards, so a disagreeing lean was dropped, not flagged. Williams rush under 85.5 was the best matchup counter (DEN 3.90 YPC, 8 runs of 10+) but his 280 yards and last4 85/135/29/116 made the counter-case stronger, so it was dropped at the pre-mortem rather than flagged.

pre_mortem: It's Monday and this lost. Pickens finished under 68.5 because Guyton or Beebe was inactive, Denver blitzed 34% and got home, and the 304 air yards became Williams/Ferguson checkdowns — a replay of the 57-yard week — while Lamb took the explosives back toward his 110-112 games. Engram finished at 29 or worse because Denver led and Dobbins closed it on the ground, so the middle never got 6 targets. Unsaved outdoor wind at a 4:25 ET kick would have done the same to both. That counter is real on OL questionables and weather, but it is not stronger than Pickens' 102-vs-68.5 gap with three of four clears, or Engram's three of four clears into a 9.75 middle YPA with Overshown out, so both stay (Engram only a lean). The Williams rush under was dropped here: Denver's 3.90 YPC and Dallas's questionable OL are a real under case, but 280 yards in three weeks and three clears of 85.5 are the stronger counter.
slip_story: One high-total pass script, not a mix. DEN 27.5 / DAL 24.0 means both pass games stay live. Pickens over is the dog's air-yard leg; Engram over is the favorite's TE leg into a bleeding middle and a missing LB. They win together if the 51.5 game stays competitive and lose together if it becomes a weather slog or a Denver clock-kill. No TD legs, one market per player, no depth receiver, no total under stacked with these overs. Dobbins rush over was the favorite-runs-the-clock piece and was left off because it needs a different emphasis and the recent yards disagree.
